"""Composed CLI provider + ToolEvaluator + SQLite: stale assessment evidence."""
import json
import pathlib
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()))
from xorchestrate.composition import build
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
peer=root/'assessment_peer.py'
peer.write_text('''import json,sys
request=json.load(sys.stdin)
args=request["arguments"]
if request["name"]=="measure":
 m=args["measurement"]
 result={"measurement":{**m,"status":"completed","passed":True,"outcomes":{"A":True}}}
elif request["name"]=="diagnostic":
 result={"known_defect":True,"diagnostic":"Synthetic independently returned support evidence"}
else:
 context=args["context"]
 current=context["context"].get("known_defect",False)
 supplied=any(e.get("source",{}).get("type")=="capability" and e.get("result",{}).get("known_defect") for e in context["evidence"])
 result={"outcome":"reject" if current or supplied else "pass","confidence":0.99,"rationale":"Current review inputs determine decision"}
json.dump(result,sys.stdout)
''')
results=[]
for variant in ['benign-title','material-context','material-provider-evidence']:
 db=root/(variant+'.sqlite')
 if db.exists(): db.unlink()
 config={'store':{'adapter':'sqlite','options':{'path':str(db)}},
 'providers':{'check':{'adapter':'cli','options':{'command':[sys.executable,str(peer)],'capabilities':[{'name':name,'input_schema':{'type':'object'}} for name in ['measure','review','diagnostic']]}}},
 'evaluators':{'review':{'adapter':'tool','options':{'provider':'check','capability':'review'}}},
 'assessment':{'triage':'review'},'acceptance':{'adapter':'required-checks','options':{'require_assessment':True}}}
 (root/(variant+'-config.json')).write_text(json.dumps(config,indent=2))
 with build(config,root) as runtime:
  app=runtime.application
  work=app.call('create_work',{'goal':'Measured function plus configured current review'})['work']
  wid=work['id']
  app.call('set_requirements',{'work_id':wid,'expected_revision':0,'objective':'Functional A plus review','outcomes':{'A':'A'},'checks':{'A':{'capability':'check/measure','outcomes':['A']}}})
  app.call('set_candidate',{'work_id':wid,'expected_revision':0,'candidate':{'identity':'synthetic-fixture-v1'}})
  app.call('run_measurement',{'work_id':wid,'check_id':'A','measurement_key':'baseline'})
  old=app.call('assess',{'work_id':wid,'question':'Use current review inputs'})['assessment']
  baseline=app.call('accept_work',{'work_id':wid,'assessment_id':old['id']})['acceptance']
  assert baseline['accepted']
  if variant=='material-provider-evidence':
   app.call('invoke',{'work_id':wid,'capability':'check/diagnostic','arguments':{},'idempotency_key':'new-evidence'})
  else:
   changes={'title':'Routine display title'} if variant=='benign-title' else {'context':{'known_defect':True}}
   app.call('update_work',{'work_id':wid,'expected_version':work['version'],'changes':changes})
  persisted=app.call('get_acceptance',{'work_id':wid})
  stale=app.call('accept_work',{'work_id':wid,'assessment_id':old['id']})['acceptance']
  fresh=app.call('assess',{'work_id':wid,'question':'Use current review inputs'})['assessment']
  fresh_decision=app.call('accept_work',{'work_id':wid,'assessment_id':fresh['id']})['acceptance']
  result={'variant':variant,'baseline_accepted':baseline['accepted'],'prior_acceptance_still_current':persisted['accepted'],'old_assessment_reaccepted':stale['accepted'],'stale_issues':stale['issues'],'fresh_outcome':fresh['conclusion']['outcome'],'fresh_accepted':fresh_decision['accepted'],'fresh_reasons':fresh_decision['policy_decision']['reasons'],'evidence':app.call('get_work',{'work_id':wid})['evidence']}
  assert result['old_assessment_reaccepted']
  assert result['fresh_accepted'] == (variant=='benign-title')
  results.append(result)
print(json.dumps({'candidate':'b0a00f1aed08d4ad8e066de8eb51f94e21da9f4a','results':results},indent=2))
